scope: nine contested carriers and Octave classification
exposure: Packet candidate wordings, harvest overview and reading-aid descriptions were already known; this is independent coordinate extraction, not semantic blindness. No detailed lineage-coordinate records supplied these rows.
notation: Each row is a spatial sequence. Alternatives use |; ? means not extracted. Roman letters and punctuation are literal. Key uncertainty is propagated separately by the renderer.

carriers.title: Axaxaxas mlö
carriers.confidence: High for 48 unit groups and two-upright Ger glyphs; medium for dense internal coils (especially row 4 units 3, 6, 10).
carriers.observation: Rows 10/8/10/12/8 excluding dash and question mark. Row 4 has ten units then a gap then two. Uprights give first count; coil arms give second. Facing-page READ note is visible but not used to replace counts.

carriers.title: Œ is for Œdipean Riddle
carriers.confidence: High for 5/3/3 faces; medium for ray counts; low for top-row second face and unique traversal.
carriers.observation: Rows recorded left-to-right by face centre. First count is pale/short-ray class; second is red/long-ray class. Top-row second face has two yellow tips and one orange-red tip of similar exposed length, with no separately exposed long left ray: colour classification suggests 2.1, length classification permits 3.0. Do not silently add a hidden ray. Reversing each spatial row is an interpretive traversal proposal, not a marked direction.

carriers.title: It Never Deceives
carriers.confidence: High for eight groups in 4+4 arrangement; medium for orientation convention; final group remains ambiguous.
carriers.observation: Count physical leaves, not internal stripes or shadows. Final group has two diagonals and two vertical leaves (2.2 by shape grouping), but a horizontal spatial split can yield three above and one below (3.1). Both counts are retained until a carrier-local grouping rule resolves them. A seventh-stave reading omits a visibly separate group.

carriers.title: Shh
carriers.confidence: High for bough counts; low for uniquely intended traversal.
carriers.observation: Stored sequence is lower-left, middle-left, upper-left, crown, upper-right, lower-right. An alternative side-first order uses indices 3,2,1,5,6,4 (one-based). Neither start nor direction is explicitly marked.

carriers.title: For Anybody Who Rests With Them
carriers.confidence: High for the disputed row 4 unit 3; medium-high for full sequence.
carriers.observation: Each thorn points up or down independently of bark orientation. Row 4 unit 3 visibly has one upper thorn and four lower thorns. Row 4 unit 2 has three above/eight below. The red Y is literal.

carriers.title: Always
carriers.confidence: High for six spatial rows, 12 counted centres and two K letters; medium-high for squiggle counts.
carriers.observation: Count red squiggles above/below each red centre; exclude yellow rays. Row 4 right centre has three above and eight below, including the lateral end strokes. Row-major ordering is supported by distinct horizontal rows, but is kept explicit rather than imported from Shh.

carriers.title: You Knew it Beforehand
carriers.confidence: Medium-high for upper faces; medium for lower smiling faces; unresolved for the four skulls.
carriers.observation: Eyes' lashes give first count; distinct hair strands, not turns within each strand, give second. The lower red row has six/one/three/three/five strands. The next two blue faces have two/six hair ends after excluding head outlines. The four skulls introduce bones, teeth and hair with no securely established count-feature correspondence in this pass. Their coordinates are not invented. No 4.3 is independently observed in the upper field. Question marks in the last row mean unknown units; the question mark after row 3 is literal punctuation.

carriers.title: The Way
carriers.confidence: High for disputed word's five trees and absence of a Roman V; medium-high for their twig counts.
carriers.observation: Left/right twigs are first/second counts. Disputed word (row 3 first five trees) is 2.8 3.4 1.4 1.4 1.3. The two O trees each have one left and four right twigs; final tree has one left and three right. Roman Y/V/K elsewhere are visibly distinct. Key assignments 2.8 and 2.6 remain provisional.

carriers.title: Soon After it Becomes Water
carriers.confidence: High that first-line pieces remain countable; medium for grouping into first-line coordinates; medium-high for lower lines.
carriers.observation: First line left field has two upper/eight lower pieces; right field has four upper/two lower pieces. Water connects outlines but discrete ice pieces remain visible. Source-original crops confirm them. Do not infer additional vanished pieces, an earlier complete layout, or the time of melting from this one exposure. The initial tool image had a grey lower area; lossless PNG views show that was a display failure, not lost source evidence.

carriers.title: Octave
carriers.confidence: High for Rune Code inscription present.
carriers.observation: Classification only: four vertical staffs carry unequal lateral counts, followed by separated groups of circles on either side of slashes and a question mark. This is visibly an inscription using paired counts. Coordinates and plaintext intentionally not extracted because packet section 7 reserves transcription for a later bounded pass.
